summary: Full backend + frontend testing of VidyaLab. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass covering auth (admin/teacher/student, dup email, invalid role, no-token 401), batches (create, list, join, RBAC, bad code), notes with AI (create with 5+ sections, image_prompt not leaked, media serves image bytes, student can read), timed tests (create, student list is_active, correct_index+explanation hidden from students, teacher preview shows answers, submit+review, double submit blocked, get-after-submit 403), DPP (create without batch, visible to any student, repeatable submit), stats (teacher/student/admin). Frontend: landing loads, register-as-student redirects to /dashboard, DPP quick action lists 2 DPPs, opening DPP shows quiz runner WITHOUT timer, answering + submitting reaches result screen with per-question review; timed test flow works with visible countdown timer decrementing from 15:00 -> 14:59, submit produces score + explanations; admin login shows teacher-style quick actions; invalid login stays on /auth.

issues: 'Welcome to School of Maths!' sonner toast (top-right) overlaps the navbar user name/role badge for ~3s after login, causing text overlap on the top-right corner. Consider positioning toast lower or shortening navbar user block.

action_items: (Optional) Reposition sonner toast or navbar user block to avoid brief overlap after login.
critical_code_review_comments: GenerateTestInput accepts kind as free string; backend does not validate it in ('test','dpp'). A malformed kind would still create a test; add pydantic Literal[...] validation.

GET /api/tests/{id} for a student who already submitted returns 403 which then triggers QuizRunner nav(-1) toast — consider a friendlier UX (show 'already submitted, view result') instead of bouncing back.
server.py is 622 lines mixing storage, auth, LLM, and routes; should be split into modules per the 700-line guideline before it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ users, one TEST Batch A, one AI-generated note 'TEST Gravitation' (with generated concept images), one timed test 'TEST Gravitation MCQ' bound to the batch, one 'TEST DPP', plus a UI-facing timed test 'UI Timed Test' (batch UI Timed Batch). Admin admin@vidya.com/admin123 verified working.
test_credentials: admin@vidya.com/admin123 (verified). Fresh teacher/student accounts created per test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and consolidates the stateful flow into one class (TestFullFlow) to remain compatible with pytest-xdist loadscope. Note generation takes 30-90s and test/DPP generation 10-30s — use timeouts >=180. DPPs are visible to ANY student without a batch (by design). correct_index and explanation are correctly stripped only in _strip_answers path (student GET /api/tests/{id}); teacher preview and submit responses intentionally include them.
